evidence.claim: Typical loop times: Non-RT 1 s or more, Near-RT about 10 ms or more, E2 Node below 10 ms.
The E2 interface supports near-real-time latency from 10 ms up to 1 s.
On TNGRELOCprep expiry the source NG-RAN node initiates the Handover Cancel procedure with an appropriate cause.
If the target or 5GC cannot accept, the AMF sends HANDOVER PREPARATION FAILURE with a cause value.
An unknown RAN Function ID IE leads to RIC SUBSCRIPTION FAILURE with a cause value.
On TRICEVENTcreate expiry the Near-RT RIC initiates RIC Subscription Delete with the same RIC Request ID and ignores late replies.
